purpose: Use this verified MF failure, root cause, fix and verification in the HW6 report discussion.

userProvidedNarrative.whatWasWrong: MF produced nearly identical predictions close to the global mean rating mu, poorly distinguishing between users and movies.
userProvidedNarrative.rootCause: MSE was averaged over the current mini-batch, while the L2 penalty was summed over all user and movie factors on every batch. With the configured coefficient, this imbalance suppressed factor learning.
userProvidedNarrative.whatWeFixed: We averaged the L2 penalty over the user and movie factor rows involved in the current batch, aligning its scale with MSE.

implementation.averagingUnit: Observed ratings in the current batch. Gathered factor rows retain duplicate observation weighting; this is not a mean over unique users or unique movies.
implementation.unobservedPairs: No rating target; unrelated factor rows do not contribute to this batch loss.

verificationEvidence.regressionTestName: MF loss: unrated factor rows have zero gradient and do not change the loss
verificationEvidence.regressionCheck: Removing unrelated rows with large factor values leaves the loss unchanged; unused rows have zero gradients, observed rows have learning gradients; no retained tensors.
verificationEvidence.status: Preserved evidence from the completed post-fix run; not a new test run in this save-only turn.
verificationEvidence.checkedBy: agent; do not describe as student personal verification without confirmation

postFixModel.model: Standalone global-mean plus dot-product MF baseline; no completed Week-5 checkpoint available
postFixModel.selection: Earliest epoch attaining the lowest validation RMSE out of 30 epochs; test not used

reportCaveat: Use the current standalone MF baseline and its post-fix outputs. Do not reuse pre-fix MF evaluation metrics as current results.
